input_format: protobuf text format, proto2 HttpProto with required string fields request and reply
configuration_profile: upstream embedded HTTP reverse proxy configuration

scopes.contract: Incremental request-line parser over r->header_in; returns NGX_OK, NGX_AGAIN, or an NGX_HTTP_PARSE_* rejection and retains r->state between calls.
scopes.preconditions: An nginx HTTP request and input buffer created by ngx_http_init_connection.

scopes.contract: Incremental single-header parser using r->state; returns NGX_OK, NGX_AGAIN, NGX_HTTP_PARSE_HEADER_DONE, or an invalid-header code.
scopes.preconditions: A parsed request line or an upstream header buffer and configured underscore policy.

scopes.contract: Normalizes a previously parsed complex URI into r->uri; returns NGX_OK or NGX_ERROR.
scopes.preconditions: Request-line parser populated uri_start/uri_end and flags; request pool and output URI storage are valid.

scopes.contract: Stateful chunk framing parser; updates ngx_http_chunked_t and returns NGX_OK, NGX_AGAIN, or NGX_ERROR while callers consume payload.
scopes.preconditions: Zeroed/preserved chunk context and a bounded buffer whose pos/last are maintained by the real HTTP body path.

scopes.contract: Incremental upstream HTTP status parser; returns NGX_OK, NGX_AGAIN, or NGX_ERROR and fills ngx_http_status_t.
scopes.preconditions: A live proxy upstream request and reply buffer supplied by the adapter.

scopes.contract: Consumes one complete PROXY v1/v2 header and returns the first byte after it, or NULL on rejection; stores parsed metadata in c->proxy_protocol.
scopes.preconditions: Connection log and pool are valid; buf..last is one contiguous candidate header (not a streaming contract).
scopes.reachability: The embedded upstream listener has no proxy_protocol parameter, so this function requires a measured follow-up target if coverage remains zero.

expected_results: normal completion for accepted and rejected HTTP messages
state: The nginx cycle is initialized once; request connections and pools are created and finalized for every input.
known_limitations: Input is delivered by the upstream recv adapters, not a real TCP stack.
The embedded listener does not enable PROXY protocol, TLS, HTTP/2 or HTTP/3.
The upstream send/event/syscall wrappers intentionally model only the behavior needed by this target.
